name: qpu-style
title: QPU style
description: styleOf(uuid): the CSS variables of a block computed from its address; nothing loaded

files.content: export const styleOf = (uuid: string) => { const hex = uuid.replace(/-/g, ''); const program = [...hex.slice(8, 20)].filter((_c, i) => i !== 4 && i !== 8).map((c) => parseInt(c, 16)), tail = hex.slice(20); const hue = parseInt(hex.slice(0, 8), 16) % 360; const [c, m, y, k] = [8, 11, 14, 17].map((i) => parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 3), 16) / 0xfff); const rgb = (v: number) => Math.round(255 * (1 - v) * (1 - k!)); const sat = 40 + (program.reduce((n, d) => n + d, 0) % 40); const radius = 2 + (parseInt(tail.slice(0, 1), 16) % 14), gap = 4 + (parseInt(tail.slice(1, 2), 16) % 12); return { '--qpu-hue': String(hue), '--qpu-accent': `rgb(${rgb(c!)} ${rgb(m!)} ${rgb(y!)})`, '--qpu-surface': `hsl(${hue} ${Math.round(sat / 4)}% 97%)`, '--qpu-ink': `hsl(${hue} ${Math.round(sat / 3)}% 14%)`, '--qpu-radius': `${radius}px`, '--qpu-gap': `${gap}px` } as React.CSSProperties }
